text.tspan: When we calculate the mean, we will round our results to one decimal place more than the original
data. For example, if the data are whole numbers, we should round the mean to one decimal place.
If the data are rounded to one decimal place, we should round the mean to two decimal places.

Find the mode for the number of spam calls in
In example 1 in section 2.2 we created the frequency table for the number of spam calls distribution.
Since the number of calls with the highest frequency was 1 call per day, which occurred 6 times, the
mode number of spam calls is 1.
Now we have seen three methods to determine a “center” or “typical” observation in the data. Which one is
the best to use? That depends on the type of data and the distribution.
